title: insulationCoordination
description: Required clearance / creepage / distance-through-insulation and withstand-voltage figures for a component. Mirror of MAS schemas/outputs.json#/$defs/insulationCoordination so safety / EMC capacitors and isolated semiconductors can use the same shape.

creepageDistance.description: Creepage distance required for this component, in m

clearance.description: Clearance required for this component, in m

distanceThroughInsulation.description: Distance through insulation required for this component, in m

withstandVoltage.description: Voltage that the component withstands, in V

withstandVoltageDuration.description: Duration of the voltage test, in s. Absent if the test specification does not require a fixed duration.
